inputs.userTask: Procurement managers who cross-reference three spreadsheets every Monday to flag late purchase orders before the weekly planning meeting
inputs.currentSolution: Excel + email chains. Takes 2–3 hours, misses things, no real-time view. Manager has to manually ping 4 different people to get status updates.
inputs.successState: Walk into Monday's planning meeting already knowing which POs need intervention — no prep work. Automated alerts when a PO is likely to be late based on vendor patterns.
inputs.constraints: Enterprise customers, SAP integration required, strong compliance environment. Data cannot leave EU region.

prompt:
You are an AI Product Strategy evaluator. Analyze this AI use case.

Context:
- User & Task: Procurement managers who cross-reference three spreadsheets every Monday...
- Mode: AI-Augmented

Key risks to check: step count, persona split, trust gap, compliance surface, action gap.
If most sub-tasks are deterministic, recommend removing AI entirely.
Kill factor must be specific. If fixable, say how.

Respond ONLY with valid JSON...

evaluation.functionalJob: Walk into Monday's planning call knowing which purchase orders need intervention, without manual spreadsheet cross-referencing
evaluation.emotionalJob: Confidently lead the planning meeting as the person who always has the answer, not the one scrambling for data

subtasks.why: API integration, structured data — no AI needed

subtasks.task: Detect orders likely to be late

subtasks.why: NLP summarization of unstructured vendor notes

risks.title: Action gap
risks.description: Procurement flags the issue but can't force vendor compliance — requires escalation to sourcing team who may not act.

risks.title: Trust gap
risks.description: Users won't skip manual verification until AI proves accurate over 4–6 weeks. During this period, it's additive work.

moat.summary: Workflow moat is real if SAP integration becomes the switching cost. Data moat builds slowly as vendor patterns accumulate.

buildBuyIntegrate.rationale: SAP integration and EU compliance requirements make off-the-shelf solutions unlikely. Moat is in workflow embedding.

riskFactor.insight: IT deprioritizes SAP integration because procurement isn't revenue-generating. Feature never gets past pilot because the data pipe doesn't exist.
riskFactor.howToFix: Secure IT commitment in writing before dev starts. If unavailable, pass.

bottomLine.condition: Only if IT commits to SAP integration timeline before sprint planning.

evaluation.nextStep: Show mock AI summary (generated manually from last week's data) to 5 procurement managers. Observe if they'd trust it without checking.

feedback.notes: The action gap insight was exactly what we'd been missing. Sent this directly to our PM lead.
